name: inter.face
description: Art direction for any interface — web, mobile, tablet, desktop, page-shaped or tool-shaped. Direction, then craft, then system, with three human gates. Stops before code.

plugins.name: inter.face
plugins.description: Skill + six agents (redesign-scout, direction-conductor, surface-designer, craft-conductor, technique-prototyper, system-builder) that turn an inbox and a six-row brief into DIRECTION.md, tokens.json, one comp per surface — coded by default, a generated image when the run opts in — a navigable board, one measured prototype per technique, and a component sheet built from the tokens.
